title: Drinking Water — Specification (Second Revision)
scope: Prescribes the quality requirements and permissible limits for drinking water intended for human consumption.

mandatory_clauses.title: Essential Requirements
mandatory_clauses.content: pH: 6.5 - 8.5; TDS acceptable limit: 500 mg/l, max 2000 mg/l.

mandatory_clauses.title: Bacteriological Quality
mandatory_clauses.content: E. coli or thermotolerant coliform bacteria must be zero in any 100 ml sample.

mandatory_clauses.title: Toxic Substances
mandatory_clauses.content: Lead max 0.01 mg/l, Arsenic max 0.01 mg/l, Fluoride max 1.0 mg/l.

title: High Density Polyethylene (HDPE) Pipes for Water Supply — Specification
scope: Covers requirements for HDPE pipes from 16 mm to 1000 mm nominal outer diameter for water conveyance.

mandatory_clauses.title: Raw Material
mandatory_clauses.content: Virgin PE-63, PE-80, or PE-100 designation with designated MFI tolerance.

mandatory_clauses.title: Hydrostatic Strength
mandatory_clauses.content: Must endure 100 hours at 80 deg C without rupture or localized ballooning.

title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets for Domestic and Similar Purposes of Rated Voltage up to and Including 250 V
scope: Specifications for 2-pin and 3-pin plugs and sockets (6A and 16A) for Indian household electrical installations.

mandatory_clauses.title: Protection Against Electric Shock
mandatory_clauses.content: Live parts shall not be accessible when plug is in partial or complete engagement.

mandatory_clauses.title: Temperature Rise Test
mandatory_clauses.content: Max permissible rise of terminals is 45 K under nominal rated current for 1 hour.

title: Information Technology Equipment — Safety (General Requirements)
scope: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) standard for power adapters, laptops, mobile phones, and visual display units.

mandatory_clauses.title: Components Safety
mandatory_clauses.content: Power cords and mains disconnect switches must comply with respective IS standards.

mandatory_clauses.title: Electric Strength Test
mandatory_clauses.content: Withstand 3000 V AC between primary circuit and protective earth for 60 seconds.

title: Lamp Controlgear — Particular Requirements for DC or AC Supplied Electronic Controlgear for LED Modules
scope: Specifies safety requirements for electronic controlgear for use on d.c. supplies up to 250 V and a.c. supplies up to 1000 V.

mandatory_clauses.title: Insulation Resistance
mandatory_clauses.content: Minimum insulation resistance of 2 MOhm between live parts and enclosure.

mandatory_clauses.title: Fault Conditions
mandatory_clauses.content: Driver must not emit flame or molten material under short circuit or open circuit.

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement
scope: Covers technical requirements for Fe 415, Fe 500, Fe 550, and Fe 600 grade TMT steel bars for structural RCC construction.

mandatory_clauses.title: Chemical Composition
mandatory_clauses.content: Carbon max 0.25%, Sulfur max 0.045%, Phosphorus max 0.045%.

mandatory_clauses.title: Tensile and Yield Properties
mandatory_clauses.content: Yield stress 500 N/mm2 min for Fe 500 with minimum 12.0% elongation at break.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement — Specification (Sixth Revision)
scope: Covers manufacture and chemical/physical requirements for 33, 43, and 53 grade Ordinary Portland Cement.

mandatory_clauses.title: Chemical Requirements
mandatory_clauses.content: Insoluble residue max 5.0%, Magnesia max 6.0%, Total sulfur content max 3.5%.

mandatory_clauses.title: Compressive Strength
mandatory_clauses.content: 28-day compressive strength must meet or exceed 53 MPa for 53-grade OPC.
